BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Venena Metacoenubia!!
The time has finally come...\nAnd the reinforcement troops...
Of course they won't come here...\nWelp, we're gonna be all right!
We just need to destroy that stupid rolling ball\nright?!
So annoying...
V-Venena!!
I bet it's difficult to communicate with lowlings\nlike you in my original superior form, so I\ntransformed into a lowling too.
Haven't you learned your lesson yet?\nDid you forget that we together with Balft beat\nyou to a pulp the other day?!
Shut up!! I'm neither that lil' empress nor a\ncluster of Coenubias that are becoming one!!
Not an empress and not a Coenubia?\nThen what are you?!
We, Coenubias, are all in one and one in all...\nAll of us, including myself, share a mind and are\ndifferentiated from this stem sphere...
However, I'm going to absorb it into my body and\nturn myself into the inimitable and the\ninvincible!!
It's all mine now!\nI can control its tissues freely and turn into\nwhatever I want!!
Wa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!!
Ha...haha! All we can do is laugh at this point!!
Don't waste your energy!\nYou guys better humor me now if you still wish to\nsee the sun tomorrow!
I feel bad saying this, b-but...I think...\nThis is it...Better prepare yourself for a good\nscolding session once we get to the Dark Realm...
Wa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! You're so determined!\nWell then, go and suffer more in hell!!
Heyy, you can't just go to the Dark Realm without\nour permission!
Hi, adventurer! Long time no see!
Just look at you now! Didn't we tell you to let us\nknow whenever you're gonna do something like\nthis?!
Huh! Who the hey are you lot?!
I'm one of the 12 holy gods, Dunkelis, the Goddess\nof Darkness. In the name of the dark, I command\nyou to return to where you belong immediately!!
This world was created by the 12 holy gods...\nIt's not a place for a strange creature like you\nto roam free and wild!!
If you insist on behaving violently, Vatendeth\nthe Dark General and I will take you on,\nyou lil' piece of monster!!
Huh?! The Goddess of Darkness and her generals\nare gonna...Oh wow wow wow...
Shut up, shuuut uppp! Don't ya know I'm Venena\nMetacoenubia?! I've mega evolved and I'm the one\nand only organism surpassing Coenubia! Note that!!
If you have no idea how great I am,\nI'll show you my true powerrr!!
Ggroaaar?!
Adventurer!\nLet's beat this Coenubia together!!
Yeah! Let's make this quick!!\nReady munchkin?!
Of course!!\n...And my name's Pelulu, not munchkin!
I-it's not over yet! The battle has just begun...
W-whoat?!
N-no way?!
Stop it! I control you guys...\nNo, stop! I'm your...\nAhh! Aaargh...
Ugh...
D-did she just get sucked in alive...?
W-what...
Let's stop it...We have used up our energy and\ngot injured more than we expected...
Although we've been in this world for a while, we\nseemed to have underestimated your power too\nmuch...
For a while you say? Since when were you here?!
We've been here since the chaos of the collision\nwe caused between our world of origin and this\nworld...
The world collided?! What was that?!\nI've never seen or heard about it at all!!
The chaos of the collision...\nCould it be the cataclysm?!
So the cataclysm happened not because of\nthe land being unstable?! Were the...\n12 gods also unaware of this matter?!
?! Earlier you said that you caused the collision,\ndidn't you? Does it mean that you guys were\nthe ones who did it?
Whaaaat?!
Yeah, it's an easy thing to do if we're united...\nWe had almost half of the world under control, but\nwe got stuck due to an unexpected rebellion by the
indigenous organisms. We ran out of resources and\nwe were put in a situation where we just had to\nattack back and turn the tables.
So to find new resources and eradicate the native\norganisms at the same time, we crashed our world\ninto this world and shattered it to pieces...
S-so the cataclysm was actually...An invasion from\nthe outer world...Unbelievable...\nIt was so sudden that no gods were aware of it...
And...We were planning to return after collecting\nthe resources from the shattered land, but...
The pieces of land began to merge, causing us to\nfail to escape as we got trapped within the\nfissures and we lay dormant for a long time...
However, by absorbing the energy from this\ngigantic tree, we were able to regain our power\nwhile increasing our minions.
It also enabled us to contact our fellows that\nwere dispersed all over this world...
End of a long story. Now we need to heal the\ninjuries you guys caused, so we're going home.\nTo that world...Our land of origin...Toram!!
Hey, don't run!!
I won't let you escape!!
Toram...Coenubia's land of origin...
Oh, oh my?!
This is bad, it's starting to collapse since its\nmaster left!!
Everyone, get away from here! Go go go!!
It's dangerous to run! Everybody gather up!!
